intro: Islamabad rewards visitors with leafy sectors, hill views and easy trips to Rawalpindi's bazaars. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro Bus red line links Islamabad with Rawalpindi Saddar; single ticket about Rs 30.
Orange line shuttle runs from the airport parking lot (row 22) to the Metro network for about Rs 90.
Blue and green bus lines use a separate ticketing system and run on regular roads.
Taxis are plentiful; agree the fare first, roughly Rs 200 per sector.
Careem and InDrive ride apps are the local favourite; Careem Bike is cheapest.
Car hire with driver is easy; walking is pleasant in the planned sectors but distances are long.

faisal-mosque.name: Faisal Mosque
faisal-mosque.hours: Open daily for visitors outside prayer times · check on the day
faisal-mosque.tip: Cover shoulders and legs; women should carry a scarf. Go late afternoon for soft light on the white marble.

pakistan-monument.name: Pakistan Monument
pakistan-monument.price_text: Small entry fee for the museum · check on the day
pakistan-monument.hours: Daytime into evening · check on the day
pakistan-monument.tip: Climb to the viewing terrace for a wide view over the city. The small museum inside explains the four provinces.

jinnah-park.name: Jinnah Park
jinnah-park.hours: Open daily, roughly dawn to dusk
jinnah-park.tip: Large green space with walking tracks. Good for an early morning walk before the heat.

jungle-world.name: Jungle World
jungle-world.price_text: Ticket price varies by ride · check on the day
jungle-world.tip: Family amusement area inside Jinnah Park. Best for kids; confirm ride tickets at the gate.

lake-view-park.name: Lake View Park
lake-view-park.price_text: Free entry · small fees for some activities
lake-view-park.hours: Open daily, roughly dawn to dusk
lake-view-park.tip: Lakeside walks and picnic spots. Bring water and sun protection; shade is limited at midday.

shakarparian.name: Shakarparian Hills
shakarparian.price_text: Free to walk · museum fees separate
shakarparian.tip: Wooded hills between the monument and the lake. Combine with the Pakistan Monument in one trip.

taxila.name: Taxila ruins
taxila.price_text: Small entry fees at individual sites · check on the day
taxila.tip: An ancient Buddhist site about an hour's drive from the city. Hire a guide or driver for the day; sites are spread out.

saidpur-village.name: Saidpur Village
saidpur-village.price_text: Free to walk · cafes charge separately
saidpur-village.tip: Old village lanes turned into cafes and craft shops. Go for an evening stroll and a meal.

daman-e-koh.name: Daman-e-Koh viewpoint
daman-e-koh.tip: Hilltop terrace looking over Islamabad. Clear views on a good day; bring a light jacket in winter.

pir-sohawa.name: Pir Sohawa viewpoint
pir-sohawa.tip: Higher up the Margalla road than Daman-e-Koh. Popular for dinner with a city view.

margalla-trail.name: Margalla Hills trail walk
margalla-trail.tip: Marked trails start near the foothills. Go with a companion, carry water and start early.

f6-market.name: F-6 Super Market
f6-market.tip: Central spot for cafes, bakeries and small shops. Good first stop to get your bearings.

blue-area.name: Blue Area walk
blue-area.hours: Busy through the day into evening
blue-area.tip: The main commercial avenue. Walk it for banks, shops and street food; watch traffic when crossing.

melody-market.name: Melody Food Park
melody-market.tip: Street-food stalls in one place. Go hungry and try a few small plates.

lok-virsa.name: Lok Virsa Museum
lok-virsa.price_text: Small entry fee · check on the day
lok-virsa.hours: Closed some days · check on the day
lok-virsa.tip: Folk heritage and crafts near Shakarparian. Pair it with the Pakistan Monument.

rawal-lake.name: Rawal Lake shoreline
rawal-lake.tip: Quiet water views away from the city centre. Boat rides are optional; agree the price first.

city-tour.name: Half-day city tour
city-tour.price_text: ≈ PKR 5,000–12,000 per car · check on the day
city-tour.tip: A driver-guide covers the mosque, monument and viewpoints in one go. Confirm what is included before booking.

f7-park.name: F-7 Park
f7-park.tip: Shaded neighbourhood park good for a short break. Quiet on weekday mornings.

golra-sharif.name: Golra Sharif shrine
golra-sharif.tip: A historic shrine on the city's edge. Dress modestly and remove shoes before entering.

safa-gold.name: Safa Gold Mall
safa-gold.price_text: Free to enter · shops charge separately
safa-gold.tip: Indoor mall for a hot afternoon. Good for a coffee and a break from the sun.

bari-imam.name: Bari Imam shrine
bari-imam.tip: Old shrine in the hills east of the city. Dress modestly and go with a local if unsure of etiquette.

styles.blurb: Taxila ruins and old Rawalpindi, an hour away.

stays.why: Central business strip; easy taxi and Metro Bus access to most sights.
Leafy, walkable sectors with cafés, restaurants and upscale hotels near the Margalla foothills.
Good-value guesthouses and small hotels; close to Blue Area and the Metro Bus line.
Quiet, green and close to Faisal Mosque and the Margalla road; best for hill views.

food: Try Pakistani classics: chicken karahi, seekh kebabs, haleem and biryani. Portions are big; share.
Look for a local 'food street' area for grilled meat and parathas in the evening; ask your hotel which is closest.
Melt-in-mouth nihari and halwa puri are traditional breakfasts; go early before they sell out.
Vegetarians are well served: daal, chana, saag and paneer dishes are on most menus.
Tap water is not safe to drink. Stick to bottled or filtered water, and skip ice if unsure.
more_time: Add a half-day to Taxila's UNESCO ruins and museum, roughly an hour northwest by car.
Cross into old Rawalpindi for Raja Bazaar and the bazaars around Murree Road; go with a local or a guide.
In summer, head up to Murree or the Galyat hills for cooler air; check road conditions on the day.
